articles.summary: Multi-bank organizations lose 12 to 15 hours each close cycle to manual statement retrieval across portals, costing 144 to 180 annual labor hours that automation completely eliminates.
articles.title: The Cost of Downloading Bank Statements Manually at 50 Banks Is Not What You Think. It Is Higher.

articles.summary: A multifamily operator managing 60 properties with 180 accounts across 14 banks transformed their 4-hour daily positive pay workflow into a 30-minute automated process through centralized file handling and exception management.
articles.title: From 12 Bank Portals Every Morning to One Confirmation Screen: How a Multifamily Operator Fixed Positive Pay at Scale
